#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> str;

    int res = 0;
    int n = str.length();
    int i = 0;

    while (i < n) {
        int j = i;
        while (j < n && str[j] == str[i]) {
            j++;
        }
        if ((j - i) % 2 == 0) {
            res++;
        }
        i = j;
    }

    std::cout << res << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
